book_info.title: Rosie's Rainbow Day
book_info.subtitle: A Story About Feelings
book_info.theme: Emotions, self-expression, it's okay to feel
book_info.moral: All feelings are okay, and after rain comes rainbows

art_style.lighting: varies with emotion - grey for sad, bright for happy, warm throughout
art_style.texture: expressive watercolor washes that blend and flow, colors that reflect emotions

rosie.name: Rosie
rosie.description: A spirited little girl with straight red hair in a bob cut with bangs, fair freckled skin across her nose and cheeks, big expressive green eyes, and a small upturned nose. Very expressive face that shows emotions clearly.

clothing.main_outfit: A soft grey t-shirt dress with rainbow stripes at the bottom, white leggings, and red sneakers with white laces

rosie.personality: sensitive, creative, learns to express feelings

mama.name: Mama
mama.description: A loving mother with wavy auburn hair to her shoulders, fair skin with light freckles, warm green eyes, and a patient smile. Wears a cozy cream sweater and jeans.

feelings_cloud.name: The Feelings Cloud
feelings_cloud.description: A small cloud that follows Rosie, changing colors based on her emotions - grey when sad, red when angry, bright yellow when happy, soft pink when loved

settings.rosies_house: A warm, cozy home with colorful artwork on walls, comfortable furniture, big windows letting in light
settings.rainy_window: Rain streaming down a window, grey sky outside, cozy interior
settings.sunny_park: A bright green park with a playground, blue sky, sunshine, other children playing
